video_title: 1-On-1 Interview with Washington Wizards Guard Trae Young & BT | Baller Alert Show Exclusive

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on the Washington Wizards' goal of reaching the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: Obviously you got to find a way to get to the playoffs first.

text_blocks.speaker: BT
text_blocks.text: What do you feel like this season you are looking to bring towards the city?

text_blocks.speaker: Trae Young
text_blocks.text: We haven't won in a while or even been to the playoffs. So for me, you got to take steps to get to the ultimate goal and winning a championship. Obviously you got to find a way to get to the playoffs first.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on the Washington Wizards' need for health to make the playoffs
quotes.excerpt: I think we have the team to do it, but obviously you got to have health.

text_blocks.speaker: BT
text_blocks.text: What do you feel like this season you are looking to bring towards the city?

text_blocks.speaker: Trae Young
text_blocks.text: We haven't won in a while or even been to the playoffs. So for me, you got to take steps to get to the ultimate goal and winning a championship. Obviously you got to find a way to get to the playoffs first. I think we have the team to do it, but obviously you got to have health and luck on our side with that.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on Anthony Davis's commitment to playing more games
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Davis is such a professional and a top 75 player for a reason.

text_blocks.speaker: BT
text_blocks.text: Anthony Davis said that he is looking to actually play a lot of games this season. Do you believe him?

text_blocks.speaker: Trae Young
text_blocks.text: For sure. Anthony Davis is such a professional and a top 75 player for a reason of all time and he knows how to block out noise and just let certain things go and when the time is right he will speak on it. But I know he is ready to play and he is motivated to play with the guys that we have and he is going to be ready for sure.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on Jalen Brunson winning a championship
quotes.excerpt: Jalen Brunson just won a championship and he has been, you know, trading.

text_blocks.speaker: BT
text_blocks.text: Do games play a big deal when it comes to trading?

text_blocks.speaker: Trae Young
text_blocks.text: When you are not winning, things people are going to be looked at and people are going to be looking to make changes. And then obviously whenever you have been successful and then you are not as successful, people are also going to be looking to make changes and that is part of the business. Jalen Brunson just won a championship and he has been, you know, trading.

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young on the perception of small guards winning championships
quotes.excerpt: Seeing Jalen Brunson win obviously helps a smaller guard and the perception of a smaller guard.

text_blocks.speaker: BT
text_blocks.text: Do you feel like Jalen Brunson winning a chip takes away from the narrative that small guards aren't needed?

text_blocks.speaker: Trae Young
text_blocks.text: Seeing Jalen Brunson win obviously helps a smaller guard and the perception of a smaller guard being able to win and that is not a bad thing.
